## Purpose
The up-channel REST command surface for paused/in-flight runs: transport-agnostic HTTP counterparts to the `/ws/chat` inbound handlers (gate resolution, questionnaire answers, cancel, resume, chat messages, launch, revisions) so those actions work over plain HTTP even when the SSE stream is down. Each endpoint is a thin wrapper over the same seams the WebSocket handlers already use.

## Shape
- `GateCommand` / `AnswersCommand` / `MessageCommand` / `LaunchCommand` / `RevisionCommand` / `UserMessageCommand`: Pydantic request bodies for each command family.
- `POST /{run_id}/gate` (`resolve_gate`): routes to `store.set_review_response(...)`, preserving the four-action contract (approve/reject/redo+instructions/update_specs) and the owner-scoped IDOR-safe 404 behavior.
- `POST /{run_id}/answers` (`submit_answers`): routes to `store.set_questionnaire_responses(...)`, including the force-proceed `skip_clarification` path.
- `POST /{run_id}/cancel` (`cancel_run`) and its helpers (`_arm_cancel_escalation`, `_cancel_run_without_a_live_driver`): sets the per-run cooperative cancel event, the same seam WS `cancel_pipeline` uses.
- `POST /{run_id}/resume` (`resume_run_endpoint`) / `_drive_user_resume` / `_reconcile_terminal_status`: user-triggered resume of a non-terminal run.
- `POST /{run_id}/messages` (`post_message`) plus a large support cluster (`_ConciergeCtx`, `_resolve_concierge`, `_drain_concierge_proposals`, `_persist_chat_message`, `_build_attached_files_block`): the free-chat message path, including Concierge proposal handling.
- `POST "" ` (`launch_run`) / `_drive_launch_to_queue` / `_resolve_launch_agents`: validates and launches a new pipeline run.
- `POST /{run_id}/revisions` (`create_revision`) / `_drive_revision_to_queue` / `_mint_revision_row`: creates a revision run seeded from a parent run.
- `register_live_ectx` / `unregister_live_ectx` / `_live_ectx_for_run`: the in-process registry the engine's live steering/image injection resolves against.

## Why this shape
The module docstring states the LOCK-B constraint explicitly: this module is additive over `/ws/chat` (`websocket.py`) — it reaches the existing ownership/terminal predicates and the cooperative cancel registry by read-only import, adds no new event shape, no new persistence, and does not modify `websocket.py`, so the WS and REST command paths can never diverge in behavior.
